content: where the notation INLINEFORM0 represents a vertical (row-wise) concatenation of two vectors; namely, the concatenation that results in a INLINEFORM1 -sized vector. In addition to the INLINEFORM2 parameters for the word vector representations that are provided a priori, this model introduces INLINEFORM3 parameters, where INLINEFORM4 is the number of POS-tag pairs we consider.
